title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: State Theatre, New Brunswick | 2000
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the State Theatre in New Brunswick, New Jersey, USA, on 24 May 2000.

It was the tenth show by the sixth All-Starr Band. Their North American tour lasted for 32 dates between May and July 2000.

Starr returned to the State Theatre on 5 July 2010 and 25 October 2015.

The sixth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Dave Edmunds: vocals, guitar
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Eric Carmen: vocals, keyboards, guitar, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, guitar, organ, keyboards, percussion, harmonica
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums

They were joined for this show by Jack Bruce’s son Corin during ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’.
